newsitem.title: JAPAN: Denmark launches 5.35% 3-yr yen/A$ samurai - Kankaku.
newsitem.headline: Denmark launches 5.35% 3-yr yen/A$ samurai - Kankaku.

text.p: Denmark on Tuesday launched 10 billion yen worth of 5.35 percent yen/Australian dollar dual currency samurai bonds due on November 25, 1999, lead-manager Kankaku Securities said.
The bonds are priced at par, and the coupon payments will be made twice a year.
Holders of the samurai bonds will receive A$1,115.215 for each 100,000-yen bond held at maturity and A$11,152.15 for each one million-yen bond.
The coupon will be paid in yen, while redemption will be in Australian dollars.
The breakdown of the terms is as follows.
AMT 10 bln yen COUPON 5.35 pct MATURITY Nov 25, 1999
TYPE yen/A$ samurai ISS PRICE 100 yen
